_doc: Steps and RAM regions for live_probe.py. Field: [name, offset, type] with type u8/s8/u16/s16/u32/s32/rgb (3 bytes) or char[N], arrays as type[N]. 'src' says which matching agent proposed the layout (re/match proposals, wave 1/2). Edit freely: add a region, a step or an expectation and re-run with --step.

pad.src: PadState/PadRep (saveload, emblem, w2c01, w2c02, w2c09); letter agent: 0x801A2564 held

frame.src: saveload D_800B6FC4 frame counter, D_800B6FC8 u8

credits.src: w2c07 credits s32 @0x80039CA4; w2c01 option mask u16 @0x80039CA0; paint scheme u8 @0x80039CA2

colours.src: w2c05/w2c09: rgb[4 groups H,C/G,A,B][4 slots B,O,D,J]; w2c06 called it part stock u8[2][0xA0]

owned.src: w2c07 owned part counts u8[160]; w2c09 called it Blk160 current AC

names.src: paint/name agent char[2][18]; w2c08 pilot name 0x80031BE6

mail.src: mail agent MailState: flags bit0 received, bit1 read; +0xC0 count

g_mail.src: letter agent g_mail (same object as MailState+0xC4?)

prog.src: w2c06 G progress block: Prog copy of 0x80041B10, flags[64] +0x38, order[64] +0x84

padmap.src: w2c10 pad map u32[12] (default 0x800BDDA0), config bytes 0x80048660..64

steps.where: a garage menu (any screen that reads the pad)

phases.label: cross
phases.say: HOLD the X (cross) button the whole time

phases.label: up
phases.say: HOLD d-pad UP the whole time

steps.where: the parts shop, buy menu, on a cheap part

ask.price: price you paid (number, Enter to skip)

steps.say: swap the HEAD part for a different one (change nothing else)
change ONE colour (one part group, one slot) and confirm it

ask.which: which part and slot did you change (e.g. head base)

steps.where: the name entry screen (AC name or pilot name)
steps.say: enter a NEW name and confirm it

ask.name: the new name you entered, exactly

steps.where: the mail list, cursor on an UNREAD mail
steps.say: open and read that mail, then back out to the list
change ONE button assignment and confirm it
